spokenMeaning: Mereka pulang ke hidup mereka, dan lu tetap harus hidup dengan hidup lu sendiri — jadi nggak apa-apa kalau nggak semua orang suka sama lu, karena lu memang nggak diciptain buat disukai semua orang.
viewerTakeaway: Kepentingan orang lain dan hidup lu berangkat dari titik yang sama lalu berpisah; hidup lu yang tetap jalan adalah bukti bahwa lu bebas dari penilaian mereka.

visualNarrative.action: A single small origin dot fades in at the lower-left third; both life-trails will start from it.
visualNarrative.meaning: Both lives share one starting point — separation is a choice made from here, not from nothing.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One white dot at x≈15%, y≈65% on the dark field, before any line exists.

visualNarrative.action: Headline slides in word by word: 'MEREKA PULANG. LU TETAP JALAN.' — 'JALAN' lands in gold.
visualNarrative.meaning: States the two destinations before the geometry explains them.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Two headline lines left-aligned top-left; only 'JALAN' carries the gold accent.

visualNarrative.action: A dim trail draws from the origin, curving up-right and terminating inside a cluster of five small house-blocks.
visualNarrative.meaning: 'Mereka pulang' enacted: their path ends at their own home and stops there.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Grey-white hairline bends upward and its tip disappears into the block cluster at x≈48%.

visualNarrative.action: The five house-blocks stagger into place around the dim trail's tip, then hold at low brightness.
visualNarrative.meaning: Their world is complete and closed — it receives them and is not a destination for the viewer.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Five dim rectangular blocks stacked as a small settlement; they stay at ~35% opacity.

visualNarrative.action: Label 'MEREKA PULANG KE HIDUP MEREKA' fades in under the dim trail.
visualNarrative.meaning: Names their route so the geometry cannot be misread as loss or abandonment.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One uppercase 34px label, secondary text color, sitting below the curved dim trail.

visualNarrative.action: A gold trail draws from the same origin, running shallow beneath the cluster, passing beyond it, and stopping only at the right frame edge.
visualNarrative.meaning: The viewer's life keeps going past their home and does not end where their approval ends.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Unbroken gold line from x≈15% to x≈92%, crossing under the block cluster with no bend into it.

visualNarrative.action: As the gold tip passes the cluster, the cluster visibly dims and stays dim; the trails never rejoin.
visualNarrative.meaning: Separation acts out: their world recedes the further one's own life continues.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Cluster opacity drops from 50% to 35% only after the gold line clears it; no line reconnects the two paths.

visualNarrative.action: Label 'HIDUP LU' fades in under the gold trail's far end; a final soft highlight passes along the gold line to its tip.
visualNarrative.meaning: Permission lands: this continuing path is the whole point — being liked by everyone was never the destination.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Gold label at the right edge; a subtle highlight sweep ends at the line's tip, then the frame holds still.

semanticObjects.semanticRole: Shared starting point of both lives, so divergence reads as a choice rather than an accident.
Their path: curves back and terminates inside the house cluster — 'mereka pulang'.
The viewer's path: one continuous line that passes the cluster and reaches the frame edge — an open-ended life.
semanticObjects.relationship: passes beyond houseCluster without entering it

semanticObjects.semanticRole: Five small blocks reading instantly as 'their home'; the closed world that receives them.
semanticObjects.relationship: absorbs dimTrail; is passed and dimmed by goldTrail

semanticObjects.semanticRole: Declares the split thesis; gold on 'JALAN' marks the continuing life as the valued one.
Names their destination so their leaving is neutral, not a rejection.
Names the viewer's path as sovereign: the life that keeps going.

relationships.relationship: source — one shared start the dim path leaves from
terminates-in — their path ends inside their home
passes-beyond-and-dims — the acting pair: the gold line clears the cluster and forces it to recede
labels-in-advance — 'JALAN' names what the gold line then performs

motionBeats.purpose: Establish the shared starting point before any divergence.

motionBeats.action: Headline words stagger-slide in; 'JALAN' takes a single gold highlight on landing.
motionBeats.purpose: Set the thesis and pre-assign gold to the continuing life.

motionBeats.action: Dim trail draws upward in a slow ease-out curve into the cluster.
motionBeats.purpose: Animate 'mereka pulang' as a path that ends at their home.

motionBeats.action: Five house-blocks stagger in around the dim tip, then hold dim.
motionBeats.purpose: Build their closed world with restrained sequence, no decorative flourish.

motionBeats.action: Label 'MEREKA PULANG KE HIDUP MEREKA' fades in.
motionBeats.purpose: Name their destination so their exit reads neutral.

motionBeats.action: Gold trail draws from the origin, under the cluster, out to the right edge in one unbroken stroke.
motionBeats.purpose: The core acting motion: one's life keeps moving past their world.

motionBeats.action: House cluster dims one step as the gold tip clears it.
motionBeats.purpose: Reaction shot — separation is caused by continuing, not by rejecting.

motionBeats.action: Label 'HIDUP LU' fades in; a soft highlight sweeps once along the gold line to its tip; frame holds static.
motionBeats.purpose: Land the permission and end in resolute calm instead of more animation.

compositionIntent: Horizontal split frame: headline block top-left at 8% margin; lower two-thirds holds one origin at left (x≈15%, y≈65%), a dim trail curving up-right into a five-block house cluster at x≈48%, and a gold trail running shallow beneath it out to x≈92%. One label under each trail, large negative space above the right half.
visualEvidence: Two lines leave one dot; the dim one ends inside the block cluster, the gold one crosses under it and touches the right edge.
Cluster opacity visibly drops only after the gold line passes — separation acts, not just coexists.
Only 'JALAN' and the right label carry gold; everything else is white/secondary on #0B1313.
No line ever reconnects the two paths; the gold tip holds at the frame edge.
forbiddenInterpretations: No two doors, gates, or room split — that visual was already used in this project family.
No arrows, filters, dials, or opinion bubbles; this beat is trajectory, not selection.
No literal people or figures standing between groups; trails carry the story.
No red accent — their departure is not a defeat or a conflict.
No glowing particles, camera moves, or simultaneous trail draws; entrances stay sequential.
noveltyIntent: Unlike the earlier closed-door separation, both lives share one origin and the gold path physically passes the house cluster, making separation a continuous trajectory whose cause is simply keeping going.
